name: Kaze to Hikari ga Anata ni Megumimasu Youni
original_name: 風と光があなたに恵みますように
source:
Main character returns home after a long time and is greeted by his two younger sisters. But he is interested in the myths of this place. The railway tracks that extend beyond terminal station, the village where population disappeared 80 years ago, the mourning spirit...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公久违地回到家乡，受到两个妹妹迎接。然而，他更感兴趣的是当地流传的神话：越过终点站继续延伸的铁路、八十年前人口消失的村庄，以及哀悼的亡灵…

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
